In a 2021 survey by the International Energy Agency, 62% of urban households reported reducing weekday car use. In contrast, only 37% of suburban households made the same change.

任务：哪一项与原文一致？

back_content.text: 答案：B。A larger share of urban than suburban households reported reducing weekday car use.

tips: 家庭中有多少比例改变行为，不等于每户减少了多少行程。

阅读片段：

Professor Linda Hart from Cambridge University analyzed 18 longitudinal studies published between 2008 and 2020. She found that participants who slept fewer than six hours were 1.8 times as likely to report attention problems.

任务：划去不能由材料支持的判断，保留有依据的判断。

back_content.text:
应划去：
She analyzed eight longitudinal studies.
The studies were published between 2010 and 2022.
back_content.explanation: 18项研究不是eight，2008—2020不是2010—2022，应划去2、4。1保留研究者与机构，3保留睡眠少于六小时者报告注意力问题的相对可能性。1.8 times as likely不是“增加了1.8倍”。

analysis_content.text: 18项研究不是eight，2008—2020不是2010—2022，应划去2、4。1保留研究者与机构，3保留睡眠少于六小时者报告注意力问题的相对可能性。1.8 times as likely不是“增加了1.8倍”。
tips: 倍数先判断是“为原来的几倍”还是“增加了几倍”，同时保留测量的结果。

eliminable_items.text: The researcher was Linda Hart from Cambridge University.
Participants sleeping fewer than six hours were 1.8 times as likely to report attention problems.

练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：

The OECD report released in 2023 estimated that remote workers saved an average of 72 minutes per workday. However, the same report noted that team response time increased by 14% in projects requiring cross-time-zone coordination.

任务：哪一项最准确？

back_content.text: 答案：D。The report indicates time savings and coordination costs can coexist.
back_content.explanation: 72 minutes per workday是每工作日节省分钟数，A却写每周72小时。response time increased by14%表示响应变慢，B写成下降；C改错年份。D保留省时与协调成本并存。

analysis_content.text: 72 minutes per workday是每工作日节省分钟数，A却写每周72小时。response time increased by14%表示响应变慢，B写成下降；C改错年份。D保留省时与协调成本并存。
tips: 数字同时核对单位和增减方向，尤其时间增加可能意味着效率下降。

options.text: Remote workers saved 72 hours per week.
Cross-time-zone projects saw a 14% decrease in response time.
The OECD report was released in 2013.
The report indicates time savings and coordination costs can coexist.

阅读片段：A 2022 transport review estimated that journeys on Route A could fall by up to 14% by 2030 if fares continued rising. It did not predict the same change for all routes.

任务：划去把预测年份、幅度或范围改写错误的判断。

back_content.text: 应划去：The review predicted a fall of 14% every year.；Every route would certainly lose exactly 14% of its journeys.。
back_content.explanation: by 2030 不是每年；up to 是上限，could 是可能，Route A 是限定对象。仅记住 14% 无法判断选项，必须同时核对这些范围。

analysis_content.text: by 2030 不是每年；up to 是上限，could 是可能，Route A 是限定对象。仅记住 14% 无法判断选项，必须同时核对这些范围。
tips: 分别圈出 by 2030、up to 和 Route A，检查年份、上限与路线是否被改动。

eliminable_items.text: The estimate concerned Route A under a stated fare condition.
The review predicted a fall of 14% every year.
Every route would certainly lose exactly 14% of its journeys.
The possible decline was up to 14% by 2030.

练习材料（虚构情境）
The college report recorded higher workshop attendance. A commentator suggested that the workshops might also improve final examination scores.

任务：判断：The report proved that the workshops improved final examination scores.

back_content.text: False。报告记的是参加人数；成绩改善只是评论者提出的可能性。
back_content.explanation: recorded higher attendance属于报告发现，suggested ... might improve scores属于评论者推测。判断句把后者换成report proved，既换了来源，也加强了确定程度。

tips: 同时核对“谁说的”和“说得有多确定”。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：In 2018, Singapore became the first city-state to require national data-sharing standards across public hospitals. A later policy review credited the move with reducing duplicate testing by 11% within three years.

任务：要定位这项政策要求首次提出的事件，而不是后续成效评估，应选哪组信息？

back_content.text: 答案：A。2018 + first city-state + require national data-sharing standards
back_content.explanation: 2018、first city-state和require standards共同指首次提出要求的政策节点，A正确。later review、11%与within three years描述之后的评估结果，不是政策首次实施时间。

analysis_content.text: 2018、first city-state和require standards共同指首次提出要求的政策节点，A正确。later review、11%与within three years描述之后的评估结果，不是政策首次实施时间。
tips: 题目问首次做什么，就找first加动作；问成效时再找后面的结果数字。
